title: Fixed Twin Wheel Through Hopper and Spinner Spreader
description: One complete newly authored static hand-push broadcast-spreader exterior. A broad round thick-wall open hopper narrows continuously into an open lower throat above a separate shallow horizontal disc with four thick blunt radial vanes. Two large side wheels and one full axle carry paired upright hopper supports; two rearward rising push arms end in a transverse dark grip. Two rear parking struts join one finite ground bar. The real upper/lower hopper aperture and the visible gap above the separate disc remain empty, with no contents. All profiles and entire support assembly are new, not replacing the old roller-seeder drum with two wheels or adding a hopper to an old reel mower: no transverse cutting reel, planting tube, roller drum, soil opener or working transmission. One model zero scenes. Fixed stylised parked equipment exterior only; no spreading, seed/fertilizer delivery, coverage, flow, gearing, wheel motion, balance, load, ergonomics, manufacture or safety claim. Rig animation interaction not made.
